requirements.text: honest lending, borrowing at the 95% limit, leverage by minting and repayment remain possible: the honest session runs to completion with the expected result.
every allowed operation succeeds, from any state.
a successful operation produces exactly the specified next state.
from any state, after a successful withdraw, borrow, mint, burn, transfer or donation the acting account is healthy, and after a liquidation the liquidator is healthy.
from any state, no successful operation makes a healthy account unhealthy.
in every state reachable from `genesis` by any sequence of operations, every account is healthy: no account holds more debt than its risk-adjusted collateral.
